basic_details.job_title: BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow (Chemical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus has one Junior Research Fellow vacancy on the project "Rational design of broad-spectrum antifungal peptides and peptide-based enzyme mimics for neutralization of mycotoxins", run from the Chemical Engineering and Chemistry departments. The fellowship is ₹48,100 per month including HRA @30% for 24 months. Applicants need an M.E./M.Tech., M. Pharm. or M.Sc. in the listed disciplines with at least 60% marks and must fill the Google form by 16 November 2026. The tentative online interview date is 23 November 2026.

qualification.details: A valid GATE/NET/any other National examination will be preferred. In Vitro Microbiology and Enzymology skills: antifungal assays, cytotoxicity assays, hemolysis assays, and functional assays for mycotoxin degradation, e.g. quantification via HPLC/ELISA. Experience in handling animal models for safety, pharmacokinetics and efficacy studies will be preferred.

how_to_apply: Open the Google form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/2HkVknX2J3LQJEBF6.
Fill the form before the last day to apply, 16 November 2026.
Keep your email inbox ready, because shortlisted candidates are notified by email.

The notice names no documents to attach and does not describe the form fields. Enquiries can be addressed to Prof. Debirupa Mitra, Chemical Engineering Department, BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus, [email protected].

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Rational design of broad-spectrum antifungal peptides and peptide-based enzyme mimics for neutralization of mycotoxins

content_sections.heading: About BITS Pilani
content_sections.text: BITS Pilani is the institution issuing this notice, and the post is based at its Hyderabad Campus. The research is led by three project investigators: Prof. Debirupa Mitra (Chemical Engineering), Prof. Arnab Dutta (Chemical Engineering) and Prof. Abhishek Saha (Chemistry). The notice gives joining as "at the earliest".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow post is an M.E./M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering / Biotechnology, or an M. Pharm., or an M.Sc. in Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Life Sciences / Medicinal Chemistry, or allied disciplines, with a minimum of 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA). Candidates should also be interested in pursuing a PhD in the relevant area. A valid GATE/NET/any other National examination will be preferred. In Vitro Microbiology and Enzymology skills: antifungal assays, cytotoxicity assays, hemolysis assays, and functional assays for mycotoxin degradation, e.g. quantification via HPLC/ELISA. Experience in handling animal models for safety, pharmacokinetics and efficacy studies will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹48,100 per month, inclusive of HRA @30%. The duration is 24 months, and the place of work is BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus. The notice also mentions an opportunity to register for a PhD at BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus, subject to eligibility.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BITS Pilani JUNIOR RESEARCH FELLOW
content_sections.text: Open the Google form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/2HkVknX2J3LQJEBF6 . Fill the form before the last day to apply, 16 November 2026. Keep your email inbox ready, because shortlisted candidates are notified by email. The notice names no documents to attach and does not describe the form fields. Enquiries can be addressed to Prof. Debirupa Mitra, Chemical Engineering Department, BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus, [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email at least 2-3 days before the interview. The online interview is tentatively set for 23 November 2026. The notice does not describe how candidates are shortlisted or how marks are given.
